action.prompt: The Postman collection or CI configuration has changed. Run the collection with Newman from the repo root using the documented command: set -o pipefail; newman run postman/pokeapi.postman_collection.json --reporters cli,junit,json --reporter-junit-export reports/pokeapi.junit.xml --reporter-json-export reports/pokeapi.results.json | tee reports/pokeapi.cli.txt. If the run is GREEN, report the pass/fail totals succinctly. If the run is RED, apply the procedure in skills/investigate-failing-assertion/SKILL.md: read reports/pokeapi.cli.txt and reports/pokeapi.junit.xml to locate each failing testcase and its failure message, classify the failure as an intentional documented API change versus a suspected API defect, and PROPOSE (do not auto-apply) a minimal fix. There is no application code in this repo, so never attempt to fix the API; raise suspected API defects with evidence (the failing assertion plus the response body). Never weaken, remove, or skip an assertion to get green, and keep request volume low. Postman cloud sync is optional: if a .postman.json file exists, read it for the workspace and collection IDs and mention them, but never skip the Newman run when it is absent.
